title: citrus medica f. tamurana
intro: Citrus medica f. tamurana, commonly known as the Bitter or Bergamot Orange, is a variety of the Citrus medica species, specifically a type of sour orange. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Citrus medica f. tamurana include its use as a bitter tonic to stimulate digestive function, as well as its application in aromatherapy to reduce stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, limonoids, and carotenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
